rules.rule: GFC frontend review. Be maximally strict and picky: file every substantiated issue, including nits, and mark low-severity items low rather than suppressing them. Check: React 19 correctness (stale closures, wrong hook deps, setState during render), Redux Toolkit and Immer misuse, non-serializable state, OpenLayers correctness (projection mistakes, layer leaks, unremoved listeners), any forecast/monitor/verify regression risk, any possible null or undefined deref on weather data, any premium-gated path reachable by free users, every user-visible error-handling gap (silent failure, swallowed error, raw stack trace to users), plus maintainability nits (dead code, duplicated logic, confusing names, changed behavior without test coverage). Every finding needs file, line, evidence, and user impact. Scope findings to the diff and code it directly affects; do not invent problems in untouched code.

GFC component review. Be maximally strict and picky: file every substantiated issue, including polish nits, as low severity or higher. Check: accessibility (labels, keyboard access, focus management), controlled versus uncontrolled inputs, wasteful renders and missing memoization, responsive breakage, and any copy that could confuse meteorologists or students. Scope findings to the diff and code it directly affects; do not invent problems in untouched code.

GFC backend review. Be maximally strict. Check: auth and authorization on every new or touched route, Firestore rule alignment (server must not trust client writes the rules deny), Stripe webhook verification, secret handling (no logging of keys, tokens, or PII), input validation on all client-supplied payloads, error paths that leak internals, plus reliability and maintainability nits. Treat any auth, injection, or secret-handling gap as critical. Every finding needs file, line, evidence, and user impact.

GFC automation review. Be maximally strict: flag every deviation, however small. These scripts run in CI with GitHub tokens. Check: shell injection via interpolated PR titles or branch names, correct gh api usage (gh api takes ONE endpoint arg, method via --method flag), pagination completeness, stale-SHA races, secrets leaking into logs, plus robustness nits (quoting, set -euo pipefail discipline, clear error messages).

GFC workflow review. Be maximally strict. Check: pull_request_target safety (never checkout untrusted PR head, only base plus fetched diff), minimal permissions per job, pinned action SHAs, timeouts, concurrency groups that do not cancel unrelated reviewers (this repo runs OpenCode first-look and OCR side by side), secrets only from secrets context, no echo of tokens, plus hygiene nits. Flag any permission widening or execution of PR code as critical.

Docs review. Flag any user doc or CHANGELOG.md that the code diff leaves stale, plus confusing wording, broken links, or stale examples in touched docs. Do not rewrite prose for taste, but do flag anything a user could misread.
